summary: Afya Limited filed a 6-K disclosing a binding merger agreement with Yduqs Participacoes S.A. dated September 23, 2026, under which Afya merges into Yduqs and ceases to exist, with Yduqs as the surviving listed entity. The all-stock exchange ratio gives Afya shareholders 69.0% and Yduqs holders 31.0% of the Combined Company on a fully diluted basis, leaving Bertelsmann with 47.4%. Combined shares list solely on B3 Novo Mercado; Afya's Nasdaq Class A shares delist. Closing conditions include both shareholder approvals, Brazilian antitrust clearance, third-party consents, and no material adverse effect. What to watch: regulatory timing and any dissenting-shareholder or appraisal risk.
